title: What the evaluator can identify when the full-data law is hidden: observation models A-D under one sensitivity model
status_label: EXPLORATORY/DEVELOPMENT (same population, models and environments as P2-FR1, whose Gamma* was seen in a smoke test before FR1 pre-registration; no new population was searched)

preregistration.disclosure: A timing smoke (12 intervals, E0 truth, Gamma in {1,2,NO_MODEL}, all settings) was run before this config was committed; its numbers were seen. No population, model or environment parameter was changed.

questions.Q1: Which observable information (complete cases only; + mask frequencies and unlabelled observed law; conditionals without selection fractions; oracle full-data law) makes the natural-policy risk difference identified or sign-determined under M_cc(Gamma)?
questions.Q2: Is the direct-difference interval narrower than the separate-risk interval on the same feasible set?
questions.Q3: Does a sign determination that holds at population level survive sampling uncertainty (conservative outer confidence interval, setting C)?

engineering_checks: information nesting A subset C subset D subset B
SUPPORT_ONLY vs NO_MODEL differ under a structural zero
outer CI contains the population interval whenever the box contains the truth (deterministic check)
preregistration.primary_metric: Joint interval for Delta_nat and its sign decision per setting at Gamma in the grid, E0 (MCAR) truth; Gamma* bracket for settings A and C.
preregistration.not_decision_rules: Gamma* thresholds and improvement ratios are descriptive; they are not tests of novelty, significance or publishability.
preregistration.independent_unit: one hand-specified population (n_units = 1) for population parts; finite-sample part uses 2 independent draws per n only as illustration (no coverage estimation by Monte Carlo).
stop_conditions: any uncertified LP -> FAIL, numbers not used
truth outside interval while Gamma >= Gamma_cc(truth) -> FAIL (bug)
wall time > 120 s -> remaining parts NOT_RUN

reuse: scenario, models and environments from configs/p2_first_run.json
label_availability: L1: labels observed iff R = complete (S = 1[R = 1...1])
estimand: Delta_nat = sum_{c,r} p(c,r) [L_A(c,r) - L_B(c,r)] (natural-missingness risk difference); separate risks R_A, R_B on the same feasible set

structural_zero_check.note: constructed support check, not an effect-size scenario

finite_sample.region: Hoeffding + Bonferroni box over the 13 observable cell probabilities, rounded outward to 1e-6
